facts.answer: Gerbera is a popular cut-flower crop. It prefers well-drained sandy loam, pH 5.5-7.0, temperatures 18-25°C. Provide shade in intense heat.
Powdery mildew: white powdery patches on leaves. Remove infected material, increase airflow, use sulfur-based fungicides as per label.
Prepare raised beds with compost, ensure good drainage, avoid waterlogging. Mulch to conserve moisture.
Gerbera market prices vary by season and city. Check local mandi or the Market Trends page for recent prices in Pune.
Maharashtra has diverse climates; for gerbera aim for cool nights, moderate days. Avoid prolonged high heat (>30°C) and heavy monsoon waterlogging.
